title: Data Engineering PDF Notes & Cheat Sheets
subtitle: Downloadable comprehensive PDF guides, architectural diagrams, and production best practices for Data Engineers.

topics.description: Deep-dive into Broadcast Hash Joins (BHJ), Salting techniques for resolving data skew, Adaptive Query Execution (AQE) configurations, memory management, and cluster executor sizing.
Production architecture covering Bronze ➔ Silver ➔ Gold lakehouse tiering, Delta Change Data Feed (CDF) for downstream incremental sync, OPTIMIZE, Z-ORDER, and Liquid Clustering compaction.
Enterprise data governance guide: 3-level namespace (Catalog.Schema.Table), dynamic column masking, row-level filtering, automated data lineage tracking, and cross-cloud Delta Sharing.

categories.title: Advanced SQL for Big Data Engineers

topics.topic: Advanced SQL for Big Data Engineers
topics.description: Comprehensive reference for Window functions (DENSE_RANK, ROW_NUMBER, LAG, LEAD), rolling time-series aggregations, recursive CTEs for lineage traversal, and query plan optimization.
End-to-end streaming guide covering Kafka consumer offsets, Structured Streaming micro-batch vs continuous processing, watermarking late data, and idempotent ACID Delta writes.

End-to-end build guide for an incremental, governed Databricks lakehouse over Olist e-commerce data: repo layout, batch preparation, Bronze/Silver/Gold pipelines, data-quality expectations and quarantine tables, SCD2 dimensions, governance and a sales dashboard. The shared set-up standards and full command reference follow as appendices.

A benchmarking case study on NYC TLC data: measuring and tuning Spark workloads, comparing layouts and cluster configurations, and documenting the performance and cost trade-offs. The shared set-up standards and full command reference follow as appendices.

topics.topic: Project 3: Postgres CDC Pipeline with CI/CD
topics.description: Change-data-capture pipeline from Postgres into a Databricks lakehouse, with the engineering practices around it: testable transformations, unit tests, linting and a CI/CD workflow. The shared set-up standards and full command reference follow as appendices.

Building the platform on Azure: resource group, ADLS Gen2, Key Vault-backed secret scopes, managed-identity access connectors, Azure SQL and Cosmos DB, plus diagnostic logging. The shared set-up standards and full command reference follow as appendices.
A structured bank of data engineering interview questions across 22 sections — Spark architecture and internals, PySpark, Delta Lake, streaming, Unity Catalog, cloud platforms and orchestration.
Topic-by-topic reference across Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog: what each component is, why it exists, how it works, and the details that matter in production.
55 practice questions presented three ways — the logic to reason through, the SQL solution, and the equivalent PySpark side by side.
